title: Card spec
description: The envelope every card spec shares: a `kind` that routes it to a renderer. The rest belongs to that kind (see the card-* schemas). Structure only. A value this schema accepts can still be refused by the validator: rules across fields (duplicates, a tool result that answers no call, ordering, limits that count UTF-16 units) are checked by the validators and pinned by conformance/protocol.v1.json, not here. A value the validators accept always validates.
